paper.title_en: On Thermodynamic Role of the Gauss-Bonnet Topological Term
paper.abstract_en: We revisit the thermodynamic implications of the Gauss-Bonnet topological term in four spacetime dimensions. It has been previously claimed in the literature that this term, although it does not modify the equations of motion, shifts the black hole entropy by a contribution proportional to the Euler characteristic of the horizon. We argue that this conclusion is sensitive to the choice of the boundary action on the horizon. We then identify a choice for which the Wald entropy expression naturally reproduces the Jacobson-Myers entropy, even for non-stationary black holes. We also show that there are no further contributions to conserved quantities from smooth outer boundaries, regardless of the choice of boundary conditions there and of the asymptotic behaviour of the spacetime. Moreover, we demonstrate that the topological Gauss-Bonnet term changes the critical temperature of the Hawking-Page phase transition, opening, in principle, a way for detecting its presence in the gravitational action. In fact, for a positive Gauss-Bonnet coupling constant, we observe a zeroth-order Hawking phase transition at high temperatures and pressures. While our discussion focuses on the case of the Gauss-Bonnet term in 4D, the results are more general and qualitatively apply to other Lovelock Lagrangians in their respective critical dimensions.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文直接讨论Gauss-Bonnet拓扑项对黑洞熵、Wald熵与Jacobson-Myers熵关系以及Hawking-Page相变临界温度的影响，属于黑洞热力学核心议题；论证涉及边界作用量选择与非稳态情形，理论深度较高，结论对Lovelock引力具有推广意义，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 论Gauss-Bonnet拓扑项的热力学作用
decision.abstract_zh: 我们重新审视四维时空中Gauss-Bonnet拓扑项的热力学含义。文献中此前曾声称，该项尽管不改变运动方程，却会通过一个与视界Euler示性数成正比的贡献移动黑洞熵。我们认为这一结论对视界上边界作用量的选择敏感。随后我们确定了一种选择，使得Wald熵表达式即使在非稳态黑洞情形下也自然地重现Jacobson-Myers熵。我们还表明，光滑外边界不再对守恒量产生进一步贡献，无论该处边界条件如何选择，也无论时空的渐近行为如何。此外，我们证明拓扑Gauss-Bonnet项会改变Hawking-Page相变的临界温度，原则上为在引力作用量中探测其存在开辟了途径。事实上，对于正的Gauss-Bonnet耦合常数，我们观察到在高温高压下出现零阶Hawking相变。虽然我们的讨论集中于4维Gauss-Bonnet项的情形，但结果更为一般，并定性地适用于其他Lovelock拉格朗日量在其各自的临界维度中的情形。
